blocks.zh: 筆型注射器玻璃筒規範 — 第1部分：醫療用筆型注射器玻璃筒
blocks.en: Pen-Injector Glass Cylinders - Part 1: Glass Cylinders for Medical Use in Pen-Injectors

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解ISO 13926-1在筆型注射器系統標準族中的定位，以及與ISO 11608系列、ISO 13926-2/-3的關係
blocks.en: Understand where ISO 13926-1 sits in the family of pen-injector system standards, and how it relates to the ISO 11608 series and ISO 13926-2/-3

blocks.zh: 掌握玻璃筒的六個關鍵尺寸（d1–d6、h1–h2）及公差要求，能讀懂Table 1規格表
blocks.en: Master the six key dimensions of the glass cylinder (d1-d6, h1-h2) and their tolerance requirements, and be able to read the Table 1 specification table

blocks.zh: 了解Type I硼矽酸鹽玻璃（HGA 1 / HC 1）的材料要求，以及退火品質與水解耐性測試方法
blocks.en: Understand the material requirements for Type I borosilicate glass (HGA 1 / HC 1), as well as the test methods for annealing quality and hydrolytic resistance

blocks.zh: 分析GLP-1藥物熱潮對筆型注射器玻璃筒市場的影響，從CDMO角度評估規格選擇的考量
blocks.en: Analyze the impact of the GLP-1 boom on the pen-injector glass cylinder market, and evaluate specification choices from a CDMO perspective

blocks.zh: 比較ISO 13926-1（筆型注射器）vs. ISO 11040（預填充注射器）兩種玻璃容器規範的異同
blocks.en: Compare the two glass container standards, ISO 13926-1 (pen-injectors) and ISO 11040 (prefilled syringes): similarities and differences

blocks.zh: Foreword & Introduction — 前言與導論
blocks.en: Foreword & Introduction

blocks.zh: 筆型注射器與玻璃筒的角色
blocks.en: The Role of the Pen-Injector and Its Glass Cylinder

blocks.zh: ISO/TC 76 — 這個技術委員會管什麼？
blocks.en: ISO/TC 76 - What Does This Technical Committee Cover?

blocks.zh: ISO/TC 76 專責輸血、輸液、注射及血液處理設備的標準化。ISO 13926系列（玻璃筒）、ISO 11608系列（針型注射系統）、ISO 23908（筆型針頭）都在其管轄範圍。TC 76與藥品包裝直接相關，是藥廠法規人員和CDMO需熟悉的標準組織。
blocks.en: ISO/TC 76 is responsible for standardization of transfusion, infusion and injection equipment, and blood processing equipment. The ISO 13926 series (glass cylinders), the ISO 11608 series (needle-based injection systems) and ISO 23908 (pen needles) all fall within its remit. TC 76 is directly relevant to drug packaging, so it is a standards body that pharma regulatory staff and CDMOs need to know.

blocks.zh: 類比：玻璃筒是藥品的「家」
blocks.en: Analogy: The Glass Cylinder Is the Drug's "Home"

blocks.zh: 筆型注射器（pen-injector）的結構可以想像成一支精密的自動鉛筆：玻璃筒（glass cylinder）是筆芯容器，裡面裝藥；活塞塞（plunger stopper, ISO 13926-2）是推動藥液的橡皮頭；密封件（seal, ISO 13926-3）是前端封口蓋。三者必須精確配合，ISO 13926-1管的就是這個「家」——玻璃筒本體。
blocks.en: The structure of a pen-injector can be pictured as a precision mechanical pencil: the glass cylinder is the lead-holder that contains the drug; the plunger stopper (ISO 13926-2) is the rubber head that pushes the liquid out; the seal (ISO 13926-3) is the cap that closes the front end. The three must fit together precisely, and ISO 13926-1 governs this "home", the glass cylinder body.

blocks.zh: 第四版重要變更：d1/d2/d3 由規範性改為資訊性
blocks.en: Key Change in the Fourth Edition: d1/d2/d3 Changed from Normative to Informative

blocks.zh: 2004年第三版中，外徑d1、中間徑d2、和另一徑d3是強制規格（normative）。2018年第四版將這三個外徑尺寸改為僅供參考（informative），意味著製造商有更大靈活度——這反映玻璃筒市場多樣化，只要d4–d6和h1/h2符合規格，配合ISO 11608-3驗證即可。
blocks.en: In the third edition (2004), the outer diameter d1, the intermediate diameter d2 and another diameter d3 were mandatory dimensions (normative). The fourth edition (2018) changed these three outer-diameter dimensions to informative only, which gives manufacturers more flexibility. This reflects the diversity of the glass cylinder market: as long as d4-d6 and h1/h2 meet the specification and the design is verified per ISO 11608-3, it is acceptable.

blocks.zh: 初級包裝對藥品品質的影響
blocks.en: How the Primary Packaging Affects Drug Quality

blocks.zh: Introduction 明確指出：初級包裝的性質與性能直接影響藥品的效價（potency）、純度（purity）、穩定性（stability）和安全性（safety）。這對生物製劑（蛋白質藥物）尤其重要——玻璃筒的化學耐性不足，會導致金屬離子溶出，進而引發蛋白質聚集或降解。
blocks.en: The Introduction states clearly that the nature and performance of the primary packaging directly affect the potency, purity, stability and safety of the drug. This matters especially for biologics (protein drugs): if the chemical resistance of the glass cylinder is inadequate, metal ions can leach out and cause protein aggregation or degradation.

blocks.zh: Clause 1–2: Scope & Normative References — 範圍與規範性引用
blocks.en: Clause 1-2: Scope & Normative References

blocks.zh: ISO 13926系列的標準生態系統
blocks.en: The ISO 13926 Standards Ecosystem

blocks.zh: ISO 13926 系列 — 三部曲
blocks.en: The ISO 13926 Series - A Trilogy

blocks.zh: Part 1（本標準）：玻璃筒（glass cylinder）——藥液容器本體
blocks.en: Part 1 (this standard): the glass cylinder, i.e. the drug container body

blocks.zh: Part 2（ISO 13926-2）：活塞塞（plunger stopper）——橡膠推塞，驅動藥液前進
blocks.en: Part 2 (ISO 13926-2): the plunger stopper, i.e. the rubber stopper that drives the drug forward

blocks.zh: Part 3（ISO 13926-3）：密封件（seal）——前端封口，針頭穿刺後形成密封
blocks.en: Part 3 (ISO 13926-3): the seal, i.e. the front-end closure that reseals after needle penetration

blocks.zh: 三個部件組成一個完整的primary container system，必須整體驗證（ISO 11608-3）。
blocks.en: The three components together form one complete primary container system, which must be validated as a whole (ISO 11608-3).

blocks.zh: ISO 720 vs ISO 4802 — 水解耐性的兩種測試邏輯
blocks.en: ISO 720 vs ISO 4802 - Two Test Logics for Hydrolytic Resistance

blocks.zh: ISO 720（Grain glass test）：將玻璃研碎成顆粒後測試，反映玻璃本體材料的化學耐性。分類為HGA 1（最佳）。
blocks.en: ISO 720 (grain glass test): the glass is crushed into grains and then tested, reflecting the chemical resistance of the bulk glass material. The best class is HGA 1.

blocks.zh: ISO 4802（Surface test）：直接對容器內壁進行測試，反映成品加工後的表面狀態（因為成型時高溫可能改變表面組成）。分類為HC 1（最佳）。
blocks.en: ISO 4802 (surface test): the inner wall of the container is tested directly, reflecting the surface condition of the finished article after processing (because the high temperatures during forming can alter the surface composition). The best class is HC 1.

blocks.zh: ISO 13926-1同時要求兩項：材料層面（ISO 720 HGA 1）和表面層面（ISO 4802 HC 1）——雙重把關。
blocks.en: ISO 13926-1 requires both: the material level (ISO 720 HGA 1) and the surface level (ISO 4802 HC 1), a double safeguard.

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-3 系統驗證的意義
blocks.en: Significance of System Verification per ISO 11608-3

blocks.zh: 單一組件符合尺寸規格並不夠。ISO 11608-3要求將玻璃筒、活塞塞和密封件作為系統進行驗證，確認：密封性（leakage）、注射力（glide force）、藥液相容性等。這是CDMO選擇組件時必須考量的整合性測試義務。
blocks.en: Meeting dimensional specifications for a single component is not enough. ISO 11608-3 requires the glass cylinder, plunger stopper and seal to be verified as a system, confirming leakage, glide force, drug compatibility and so on. This is an integrated testing obligation that a CDMO must consider when selecting components.

blocks.zh: Bibliography中的ISO 11608-1
blocks.en: ISO 11608-1 in the Bibliography

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-1（針型注射系統整體要求）列在Bibliography（資料性參考）而非規範性引用。這表示它提供背景框架（什麼是pen-injector），但本標準不直接要求符合ISO 11608-1的所有條款——只是在Introduction中引用其定義。
blocks.en: ISO 11608-1 (general requirements for needle-based injection systems) is listed in the Bibliography (informative references) rather than in the normative references. This means it provides a background framework (what a pen-injector is), but this standard does not directly require compliance with all clauses of ISO 11608-1; its definitions are merely referred to in the Introduction.

blocks.zh: Clause 4: Dimensions — 尺寸規格
blocks.en: Clause 4: Dimensions

blocks.zh: 尺寸規格的實務解讀
blocks.en: Practical Interpretation of the Dimensions

blocks.zh: 六個關鍵尺寸的功能說明
blocks.en: Function of the Six Key Dimensions

blocks.zh: d1（外徑）：筆型注射器外殼匹配用，改為資訊性——允許不同設備廠商設計差異
blocks.en: d1 (outer diameter): used to match the pen-injector housing; changed to informative, allowing design differences between device manufacturers

blocks.zh: d4（法蘭外徑）= 7.15±0.2 mm：唯一固定的強制外徑！筆型注射器的定位/固定結構依賴此尺寸
blocks.en: d4 (flange outer diameter) = 7.15±0.2 mm: the only fixed, mandatory outer diameter! The positioning/retention structure of the pen-injector depends on this dimension

blocks.zh: d5（桶身內徑）= 5.5±0.35 mm：活塞塞（ISO 13926-2）的配合尺寸，決定注射劑量精度
blocks.en: d5 (barrel inner diameter) = 5.5±0.35 mm: the mating dimension for the plunger stopper (ISO 13926-2), which determines dose accuracy

blocks.zh: d6（孔口徑）= 3.15±0.2 mm：密封件（ISO 13926-3）插入處，影響穿刺力和密封性
blocks.en: d6 (orifice diameter) = 3.15±0.2 mm: where the seal (ISO 13926-3) is inserted, affecting penetration force and sealing performance

blocks.zh: h1（孔深）= 5.0±0.20 mm：密封件插入深度，確保密封可靠性
blocks.en: h1 (orifice depth) = 5.0±0.20 mm: the seal insertion depth, ensuring reliable sealing

blocks.zh: h2（法蘭高）= 2.9±0.1 mm：法蘭結構高度，影響組裝穩定性
blocks.en: h2 (flange height) = 2.9±0.1 mm: the height of the flange structure, affecting assembly stability

blocks.zh: 值得注意：四種規格的d4/d5/d6/h1/h2完全相同
blocks.en: Worth noting: d4/d5/d6/h1/h2 are identical across all four sizes

blocks.zh: 仔細看Table 1——無論d1是8.65還是11.60 mm，所有四種規格的d4、d5、d6、h1、h2都是一樣的！這意味著：筆型注射器的核心配合尺寸（活塞塞介面、密封件介面、法蘭）是標準化的，只有外徑（d1-d3，資訊性）不同。這讓零組件廠商可以製作通用的活塞塞和密封件。
blocks.en: Look closely at Table 1: whether d1 is 8.65 or 11.60 mm, d4, d5, d6, h1 and h2 are the same for all four sizes! This means the core mating dimensions of the pen-injector (plunger stopper interface, seal interface, flange) are standardized, and only the outer diameters (d1-d3, informative) differ. This allows component manufacturers to make universal plunger stoppers and seals.

blocks.zh: 錐形孔口的接受標準：≤0.3 mm
blocks.en: Acceptance Criterion for a Tapered Orifice: ≤0.3 mm

blocks.zh: 玻璃成型（尤其是管制玻璃tubing process）難以保證完全圓柱形孔口，允許微錐形。但錐度差異上限為0.3 mm，且大口徑端必須靠近法蘭側——這確保密封件插入時不會因過度錐形而漏液或穿刺力異常。
blocks.en: In glass forming (especially the tubing process for tubular glass), it is hard to guarantee a perfectly cylindrical orifice, so a slight taper is allowed. However, the upper limit on the difference in diameter due to taper is 0.3 mm, and the larger-diameter end must be on the flange side. This ensures that the seal does not leak or show abnormal penetration force because of excessive taper when inserted.

blocks.zh: l1和l2：需要與客戶協議
blocks.en: l1 and l2: To Be Agreed with the Customer

blocks.zh: 筒身長度（l1）和總長（l2）沒有固定規格，由玻璃筒製造商與客戶（通常是藥廠或CDMO）協商。這是因為不同藥物劑量（如胰島素100 U、GLP-1的1週劑量）需要不同容量，容量決定筒身長度。典型商業規格從1.5 mL到3.17 mL不等。
blocks.en: The barrel length (l1) and overall length (l2) have no fixed specification and are agreed between the glass cylinder manufacturer and the customer (usually a pharma company or CDMO). This is because different drug doses (such as insulin 100 U, or a GLP-1 once-weekly dose) require different volumes, and the volume determines the barrel length. Typical commercial sizes range from 1.5 mL to 3.17 mL.

blocks.zh: Clause 5: Requirements — 材料與性能要求
blocks.en: Clause 5: Requirements - Material and Performance Requirements

blocks.zh: 為什麼用Type I硼矽酸鹽玻璃
blocks.en: Why Type I Borosilicate Glass

blocks.zh: Type I玻璃 — 藥用包裝的黃金標準
blocks.en: Type I Glass - The Gold Standard for Pharmaceutical Packaging

blocks.zh: Type I硼矽酸鹽玻璃（borosilicate glass）的化學組成約為：SiO₂ 70-80%、B₂O₃ 7-13%、Al₂O₃ 2-7%、Na₂O/K₂O <5%。硼的加入大幅提升玻璃的化學耐性，使其在酸性、中性和弱鹼性藥液中都保持穩定。
blocks.en: The approximate chemical composition of Type I borosilicate glass is: SiO₂ 70-80%, B₂O₃ 7-13%, Al₂O₃ 2-7%, Na₂O/K₂O <5%. The addition of boron greatly improves the chemical resistance of the glass, keeping it stable with acidic, neutral and mildly alkaline drug solutions.

blocks.zh: 化學耐性：不與注射用水、蛋白質、pH緩衝液反應
blocks.en: Chemical resistance: does not react with water for injection, proteins or pH buffers

blocks.zh: 低溶出：Na⁺、Ca²⁺等金屬離子溶出量極低，不影響藥品穩定性
blocks.en: Low extractables: leaching of metal ions such as Na⁺ and Ca²⁺ is very low and does not affect drug stability

blocks.zh: 熱穩定性：能承受高壓蒸汽滅菌（121°C）
blocks.en: Thermal stability: withstands steam sterilization in an autoclave (121°C)

blocks.zh: 透明度：允許目視檢查藥液外觀
blocks.en: Transparency: allows visual inspection of the appearance of the drug solution

blocks.zh: HGA 1 vs HC 1 — 兩個指標的互補性
blocks.en: HGA 1 vs HC 1 - Two Complementary Indicators

blocks.zh: HGA 1（ISO 720）：研磨玻璃顆粒（0.3-0.5 mm）在121°C、60分鐘高壓蒸汽處理後，以鹽酸滴定溶出鹼量。HGA 1代表每克玻璃溶出鹼量 ≤0.10 mL 0.01 mol/L HCl。
blocks.en: HGA 1 (ISO 720): ground glass grains (0.3-0.5 mm) are autoclaved at 121°C for 60 minutes, and the extracted alkali is titrated with hydrochloric acid. HGA 1 means the alkali extracted per gram of glass is ≤0.10 mL of 0.01 mol/L HCl.

blocks.zh: HC 1（ISO 4802）：容器內表面直接測試，溶出量以μg Na₂O/mL換算。HC 1為最高耐性等級（≤0.10 μg/mL）。
blocks.en: HC 1 (ISO 4802): the inner surface of the container is tested directly, with the extracted amount expressed as μg Na₂O/mL. HC 1 is the highest resistance class (≤0.10 μg/mL).

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要兩項？因為玻璃成型過程的高溫（≈1000°C）可能使表面組成偏析，HGA 1確保原料品質，HC 1確保成品表面性能——缺一不可。
blocks.en: Why are both needed? Because the high temperature of glass forming (≈1000°C) can cause segregation of the surface composition: HGA 1 ensures raw material quality and HC 1 ensures the surface performance of the finished article. Neither can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 矽化處理（Siliconization）— 未在標準中明文規定，但實務關鍵
blocks.en: Siliconization - Not Explicitly Specified in the Standard, but Critical in Practice

blocks.zh: ISO 13926-1本文並未規定矽化要求，但業界幾乎所有玻璃筒都會在內壁施加二甲基矽油（dimethicone）矽化層。矽化的作用：
blocks.en: The body of ISO 13926-1 does not specify siliconization requirements, but almost all glass cylinders in the industry carry a dimethicone (dimethyl silicone oil) silicone layer on the inner wall. The functions of siliconization are:

blocks.zh: 降低活塞滑動力（glide force）：筆型注射器的注射力（injection force）直接影響患者體驗，矽化可將滑動力從 >20N 降至 <10N
blocks.en: Reduces plunger glide force: the injection force of a pen-injector directly affects patient experience, and siliconization can bring the glide force down from >20 N to <10 N

blocks.zh: 防止活塞塞黏附：長期儲存中活塞塞可能與玻璃黏合，矽化防止此現象
blocks.en: Prevents plunger stopper sticking: during long-term storage the plunger stopper may bond to the glass, and siliconization prevents this

blocks.zh: 風險：過量矽化油可能產生可見顆粒（silicone droplets），造成注射液渾濁——必須控制矽化量（通常0.5-1.5 mg/mL表面）
blocks.en: Risk: excess silicone oil may produce visible particles (silicone droplets) and make the injection solution cloudy, so the amount of silicone must be controlled (usually 0.5-1.5 mg/mL of surface)

blocks.zh: 矽化量和均勻性屬於製造商的製程控制範疇，需在ISO 11608-3系統驗證中確認。
blocks.en: The amount and uniformity of siliconization fall within the manufacturer's process control and must be confirmed in the ISO 11608-3 system verification.

blocks.zh: 退火品質（Annealing Quality）— 為什麼重要
blocks.en: Annealing Quality - Why It Matters

blocks.zh:
玻璃筒成型後若冷卻不均，會在玻璃內產生殘餘應力（residual stress）。過高的殘餘應力會導致：
(1) 玻璃在儲存或使用中自發破裂（spontaneous breakage）；
(2) 在注射過程中因壓力增加而破裂；
(3) 玻璃碎片污染藥液（glass particle contamination）。
blocks.en:
If the glass cylinder cools unevenly after forming, residual stress is created within the glass. Excessive residual stress can lead to:
(1) spontaneous breakage of the glass during storage or use;
(2) breakage under the increased pressure during injection;
(3) contamination of the drug solution by glass particles.

blocks.zh: 退火（annealing）是將玻璃在退火爐中緩慢均勻冷卻，消除殘餘應力。光程差≤40 nm/mm的標準是歷史實踐的安全閾值。
blocks.en: Annealing is the slow, uniform cooling of glass in an annealing lehr to relieve residual stress. The optical path difference limit of ≤40 nm/mm is a safety threshold based on historical practice.

blocks.zh: 9個月變更通知 — 供應鏈穩定性保障
blocks.en: 9-Month Change Notification - Safeguarding Supply Chain Stability

blocks.zh: 玻璃組成的改變可能影響：溶出性（E&L study需重做）、相容性（藥品穩定性研究需重新驗證）。9個月提前通知讓藥廠有足夠時間啟動變更管理（change control），向FDA/EMA等提交SUPAC（Scale-Up and Post-Approval Changes）文件。這是藥廠採購合約的重要條款。
blocks.en: A change in glass composition may affect extractables and leachables (the E&L study would need to be repeated) and compatibility (drug stability studies would need to be re-validated). A 9-month advance notice gives the drug manufacturer enough time to start change control and to submit SUPAC (Scale-Up and Post-Approval Changes) documentation to FDA/EMA and other authorities. This is an important clause in pharma purchasing contracts.

blocks.zh: Clause 6–7: Designation & Package Marking — 標識與包裝標記
blocks.en: Clause 6-7: Designation & Package Marking

blocks.zh: 標識系統解析與CDMO實務觀點
blocks.en: Decoding the Designation System and CDMO Practical Perspective

blocks.zh: Designation 解碼練習
blocks.en: Designation Decoding Exercise

blocks.zh: 格式：Cylinder ISO 13926-1 – [色澤] – [d1尺寸]
blocks.en: Format: Cylinder ISO 13926-1 - [color] - [d1 size]

blocks.zh: 注意：designation使用的是d1（資訊性尺寸）作為識別名稱，但合規要求的是d4-d6等規範性尺寸——命名系統與合規系統使用不同尺寸基準。
blocks.en: Note: the designation uses d1 (an informative dimension) as the identifying name, but compliance requires the normative dimensions such as d4-d6, so the naming system and the compliance system use different dimensional bases.

blocks.zh: 琥珀玻璃（amber glass）的使用時機
blocks.en: When to Use Amber Glass

blocks.zh: 琥珀玻璃（"br"，源自德文Braun）可阻擋290-450 nm波長的光，保護光敏性藥物。在筆型注射器中，胰島素（insulin）通常使用透明玻璃（cl），因為患者需要觀察藥液狀態（混濁/澄清）；而某些GLP-1藥物或生物製劑若對光敏感，可能選用琥珀玻璃。但琥珀玻璃無法目視檢查藥液，需用其他方法（如宇宙射線檢測）確認內容物。
blocks.en: Amber glass ("br", from the German Braun) blocks light at wavelengths of 290-450 nm and protects light-sensitive drugs. In pen-injectors, insulin usually uses clear glass (cl) because patients need to observe the condition of the solution (cloudy/clear); some GLP-1 drugs or biologics that are light-sensitive may use amber glass. However, with amber glass the solution cannot be inspected visually, and other methods (such as cosmic-ray inspection) are needed to verify the contents.

blocks.zh: Package Marking — 最低要求，不代表全部GMP要求
blocks.en: Package Marking - A Minimum Requirement, Not the Full Set of GMP Requirements

blocks.zh: ISO 13926-1的4項包裝標記要求是最低標準。實務上，藥廠或CDMO客戶通常要求更多資訊：
blocks.en: The 4 package marking requirements in ISO 13926-1 are a minimum standard. In practice, pharma or CDMO customers usually require more information:

blocks.zh: 製造日期與有效期（shelf life）
blocks.en: Manufacturing date and shelf life

blocks.zh: 儲存條件（溫度、濕度）
blocks.en: Storage conditions (temperature, humidity)

blocks.zh: 滅菌狀態（若已滅菌）
blocks.en: Sterilization status (if sterilized)

blocks.zh: 原材料憑證（CoA, Certificate of Analysis）參考
blocks.en: Reference to the raw material certificate (CoA, Certificate of Analysis)

blocks.zh: 條碼/QR碼（用於自動化倉儲）
blocks.en: Barcode/QR code (for automated warehousing)

blocks.zh: 這些額外要求通常寫入採購規格（purchasing specification）或供應商品質協議（SQA）中。
blocks.en: These additional requirements are usually written into the purchasing specification or the supplier quality agreement (SQA).

blocks.zh: Industry Context: GLP-1 Boom & CDMO Perspective — 產業背景與CDMO觀點
blocks.en: Industry Context: GLP-1 Boom & CDMO Perspective

blocks.zh: CDMO視角：選擇玻璃筒規格的考量
blocks.en: CDMO Perspective: Considerations in Choosing Glass Cylinder Specifications

blocks.zh: GLP-1藥物熱潮對CDMO玻璃筒業務的影響
blocks.en: Impact of the GLP-1 Boom on the CDMO Glass Cylinder Business

blocks.zh: 2020年代的GLP-1藥物熱潮（Ozempic、Wegovy等）造成全球玻璃筒供應緊張。主要供應商（Schott、Gerresheimer、Nipro、SGD）產能難以快速擴充，導致：
blocks.en: The GLP-1 drug boom of the 2020s (Ozempic, Wegovy, etc.) has tightened global glass cylinder supply. The major suppliers (Schott, Gerresheimer, Nipro, SGD) cannot expand capacity quickly, which has led to:

blocks.zh: 交期從標準的12-16週延長至24-36週
blocks.en: Lead times extending from the standard 12-16 weeks to 24-36 weeks

blocks.zh: 藥廠與CDMO需提早18-24個月鎖定供貨量
blocks.en: Drug companies and CDMOs needing to lock in supply volumes 18-24 months in advance

blocks.zh: 部分GLP-1廠商轉而開發預填充注射器（prefilled syringe）格式作為替代
blocks.en: Some GLP-1 companies turning to the prefilled syringe format as an alternative

blocks.zh: 對CDMO而言，掌握ISO 13926-1規格細節，才能在評估多個供應商時快速判斷合規性。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, mastering the detailed ISO 13926-1 specifications is what makes it possible to judge compliance quickly when evaluating multiple suppliers.

blocks.zh: 玻璃筒的滅菌策略 — ISO 13926-1不規定，但實務必須考量
blocks.en: Sterilization Strategy for Glass Cylinders - Not Specified by ISO 13926-1, but Must Be Considered in Practice

blocks.zh: ISO 13926-1本身不規定玻璃筒的滅菌要求（滅菌屬於fill-finish製程範疇）。但CDMO需要考量：
blocks.en: ISO 13926-1 itself does not specify sterilization requirements for glass cylinders (sterilization belongs to the fill-finish process). However, a CDMO needs to consider:

blocks.zh: 去熱原處理（depyrogenation）：乾熱隧道烤箱，通常250°C ×30分鐘（FH≥170），消除內毒素
blocks.en: Depyrogenation: dry-heat tunnel oven, usually 250°C ×30 minutes (FH≥170), to eliminate endotoxin

blocks.zh: 洗瓶機（washer）：注射用水沖洗確保顆粒符合Ph.Eur.或USP要求
blocks.en: Washer: rinsing with water for injection to ensure particles meet Ph. Eur. or USP requirements

blocks.zh: 矽化完整性：去熱原後矽化層是否完整——需驗證
blocks.en: Siliconization integrity: whether the silicone layer is still intact after depyrogenation, which needs to be validated

blocks.zh: EtO vs 輻射滅菌：玻璃筒通常不用EtO，乾熱是主流；已組裝的子組件可能用gamma射線
blocks.en: EtO vs radiation sterilization: EtO is generally not used for glass cylinders and dry heat is the mainstream; assembled sub-components may use gamma irradiation

blocks.zh: 系統整合邏輯：三件套缺一不可
blocks.en: System Integration Logic: The Three Parts Are Inseparable

blocks.zh:
想像一個注射筆的玻璃筒系統：
玻璃筒（ISO 13926-1）是水壺本體；
活塞塞（ISO 13926-2）是水壺裡的橡皮推板，向前推動出水；
密封件（ISO 13926-3）是水壺嘴的矽膠塞，針頭刺破後釋放藥液。
三件套必須尺寸匹配、材料相容、動態性能協調——這就是ISO 11608-3系統驗證的意義。
blocks.en:
Imagine the glass cylinder system of an injection pen:
The glass cylinder (ISO 13926-1) is the body of a water bottle;
the plunger stopper (ISO 13926-2) is the rubber pusher inside the bottle that moves forward to push the water out;
the seal (ISO 13926-3) is the silicone plug in the bottle spout, which releases the drug once pierced by the needle.
The three parts must match in dimensions, be compatible in materials and be coordinated in dynamic performance, and that is the meaning of ISO 11608-3 system verification.

blocks.zh: Practice Questions — 練習問題
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 練習問題（共5題）
blocks.en: Practice Questions (5 in total)

blocks.zh:
問題1（尺寸規格）
根據ISO 13926-1 Table 1，以下哪個說法是正確的？
A. 四種規格的d4（法蘭外徑）各不相同
B. d1、d2、d3是強制規範性尺寸（normative）
C. 四種規格的d5（桶身內徑）均為5.5±0.35 mm
D. l1和l2有固定規格，不需要協議
答案：C。d4在所有規格中都是7.15±0.2 mm（同一值）；d1/d2/d3自第四版起改為資訊性（informative）；l1/l2由製造商與客戶協議。
blocks.en:
Question 1 (Dimensions)
According to ISO 13926-1 Table 1, which of the following statements is correct?
A. The d4 (flange outer diameter) differs among the four sizes
B. d1, d2 and d3 are mandatory normative dimensions
C. The d5 (barrel inner diameter) is 5.5±0.35 mm for all four sizes
D. l1 and l2 have fixed specifications and need no agreement
Answer: C. d4 is 7.15±0.2 mm in all sizes (the same value); d1/d2/d3 became informative from the fourth edition onward; l1/l2 are agreed between the manufacturer and the customer.

blocks.zh:
問題2（材料要求）
ISO 13926-1要求玻璃符合ISO 720 HGA 1和ISO 4802 HC 1，為什麼需要同時符合兩個標準，而非只符合其中一個？
答案：ISO 720 HGA 1測試的是玻璃原料本體（研磨顆粒）的水解耐性；ISO 4802 HC 1測試的是成品容器內壁表面的水解耐性。兩者可能不一致，因為高溫成型過程可能改變玻璃表面組成（surface delamination risk）。雙重測試確保材料和成品表面均達到Type I品質。
blocks.en:
Question 2 (Material Requirements)
ISO 13926-1 requires the glass to meet both ISO 720 HGA 1 and ISO 4802 HC 1. Why must both be met, rather than just one?
Answer: ISO 720 HGA 1 tests the hydrolytic resistance of the raw glass material itself (ground grains); ISO 4802 HC 1 tests the hydrolytic resistance of the inner wall surface of the finished container. The two may not agree, because the high-temperature forming process can alter the glass surface composition (surface delamination risk). Dual testing ensures that both the material and the finished surface reach Type I quality.

blocks.zh:
問題3（孔口幾何）
ISO 13926-1允許玻璃筒開口呈輕微錐形，但對錐形有何限制條件？
答案：三個條件同時滿足：(1) 錐形截頭圓錐的高度 = h1；(2) 大口徑端位於法蘭側（或依協議）；(3) 大口徑不得比小口徑超出0.3 mm。這確保密封件插入時仍能可靠密封，不因錐度過大導致漏液。
blocks.en:
Question 3 (Orifice Geometry)
ISO 13926-1 allows the opening of the glass cylinder to be slightly tapered. What conditions limit the taper?
Answer: three conditions must be met at the same time: (1) the height of the truncated cone = h1; (2) the larger-diameter end is on the flange side (or as agreed); (3) the larger diameter must not exceed the smaller diameter by more than 0.3 mm. This ensures that the seal still seals reliably when inserted, and that excessive taper does not cause leakage.

blocks.zh:
問題4（退火品質）
一批玻璃筒在應變儀（strain viewer）測試中，玻璃壁厚為1.2 mm，測得光程差為52 nm。這批玻璃筒是否符合ISO 13926-1要求？請說明理由。
答案：不符合。ISO 13926-1要求光程差≤40 nm/mm。換算：52 nm ÷ 1.2 mm = 43.3 nm/mm，超過40 nm/mm的限值。說明退火不充分，殘餘應力過高，有破裂風險，應退貨或重新退火。
blocks.en:
Question 4 (Annealing Quality)
In a strain viewer test, a batch of glass cylinders with a glass wall thickness of 1.2 mm shows an optical path difference of 52 nm. Does this batch meet ISO 13926-1 requirements? Explain why.
Answer: It does not. ISO 13926-1 requires an optical path difference of ≤40 nm/mm. Converting: 52 nm ÷ 1.2 mm = 43.3 nm/mm, which exceeds the 40 nm/mm limit. This indicates insufficient annealing and excessive residual stress, with a risk of breakage, so the batch should be rejected and returned or re-annealed.

blocks.zh:
問題5（CDMO實務）
一家CDMO正在評估為客戶的GLP-1藥物（semaglutide）生產筆型注射器填充服務。客戶希望使用d1=11.6 mm的玻璃筒。請列出至少4個在選擇玻璃筒供應商和規格時必須確認的關鍵項目，並說明各項的理由。
答案示例：(1) HC 1水解耐性CoA——蛋白質藥物對離子溶出極敏感，影響穩定性；(2) 矽化規格（矽化量、分佈均勻性）——影響注射力和微粒風險；(3) 退火品質數據（光程差合格率）——確保儲存和使用中不破裂；(4) 9個月變更通知條款是否寫入採購合約——避免未預警的原料變更影響藥品穩定性數據的有效性；(5) 系統驗證相容性（ISO 11608-3）——需確認活塞塞和密封件供應商的配合規格與此玻璃筒匹配。
blocks.en:
Question 5 (CDMO Practice)
A CDMO is evaluating pen-injector filling services for a customer's GLP-1 drug (semaglutide). The customer wants to use a glass cylinder with d1=11.6 mm. List at least 4 key items that must be confirmed when selecting the glass cylinder supplier and specification, and explain the reason for each.
Sample answer: (1) HC 1 hydrolytic resistance CoA: protein drugs are extremely sensitive to ion leaching, which affects stability; (2) siliconization specification (amount, distribution uniformity): affects injection force and particle risk; (3) annealing quality data (optical path difference pass rate): ensures no breakage during storage and use; (4) whether the 9-month change notification clause is written into the purchasing contract: avoids unannounced material changes undermining the validity of drug stability data; (5) system verification compatibility (ISO 11608-3): the mating specifications of the plunger stopper and seal suppliers must be confirmed to match this glass cylinder.
